title: Add tag-governance batch operation panel to Tag Manager
description:
## Human Auditing Recommendation 1

### Problem
The Tag Manager (`TagManager.razor`) shows per-tag governance status (allowed/blocked/alias) but has no batch operations. A human auditor who identifies that 20 records use a deprecated tag like `misc` must edit each record individually.

### Suggested Implementation
Add a batch panel to the Tag Manager with:
1. Checkbox selection on the tag usage list
2. "Replace with…" dropdown to bulk-rename selected tags across all records
3. "Remove from all records" action for blocklisted tags
4. Confirmation dialog showing count of affected records before execution

### Why It Helps Human Auditing
Makes it possible to clean up widespread tag policy violations in a single action instead of N individual edits.

### Confidence: 80%
